lastCompletedStory.title: Add loop-phase enum as single source of truth; active derives from phase

nextStoryContext: US-001 added LoopPhase enum (idle|planning|implementing|awaiting-operator|shipping) to LoopState in status.ts; parseStateFile derives active from phase when phase is present; renderStateFile in next.ts emits phase: and plan_issue: using {{PHASE}} and {{PLAN_ISSUE_YAML}} template placeholders; vendor template updated and re-embedded. All callers that pass active:boolean without phase still work (backward compat via phase derivation). Round-trip tests added in test/next.test.ts. The next story can now use LoopPhase and plan_issue fields.

officialDocsValidated.summary: load() returns null for YAML null, JS string for strings, JS boolean for booleans. Implementation correctly uses typeof checks to distinguish types; plan_issue:null in YAML yields JS null, skipped by typeof guard.
